title: Lieber Institute for Brain Development - Application Home
text:
Welcome to to the landing page for web applications that have been developed by the scientists at the Lieber Institute for Brain Development. Here you can find a list of web visualization apps that we’ve created as part of our work and have been cited in manuscripts.
To learn more about the Lieber Institute for Brain Development and our work, please, visit https://www.libd.org/.

title: Project Documentation
text: Prominent application types used in this project are shiny apps, iSEE apps, and Samui apps.

title: Lieber Institute for Brain Development - Application Home
text:
The mission of the Lieber Institute for Brain Development Maltz Research Laboratories is to translate the understanding of basic genetic and molecular mechanisms of schizophrenia and related developmental brain disorders into clinical advances that change the lives of affected individuals.
More information about the Lieber Institute for Brain Development can be found at https://www.libd.org/.
